domain: consumer product safety - per-recall lifecycle-update (scope expansion / countermeasure change) prediction from the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry consumer-product recall register (METI 製品安全ガイド リコール情報, amended Consumer Product Safety Act, coverage from 2007-05-14)
prediction_question: At a consumer-product recall's first publication on the METI recall register (リコール日/掲載日, Asia/Tokyo), predict whether the register will later record a substantive lifecycle update on that recall - 対象追加 (affected-scope addition), 型番追加 (model addition), 品番追加・対象期間拡大 (item/period expansion) or 対策内容更新 (countermeasure change) - within a pre-registered window, using only information published at the first instant (product sub-category, product name, implementing business incl. domestic/overseas-importer marker, initial date, sales period, affected-unit count, hazard/remedy fields - per-field availability to be verified on the detail pages). Cosmetic updates (問い合わせ先/電話番号/受付時間/URL更新) are excluded from the label. A useful prediction supports METI/CAA post-publication scrutiny triage and the business's own scope review: an under-scoped recall leaves hazardous units in homes and forces repeat consumer notices.
prediction_time: The recall's first publication instant on the METI register - the row's リコール日 as published, read as Asia/Tokyo. The register's own index states the ministry publishes recall information as a rule ('原則経済産業省のWebページで公表', measured 2026-11-07) and announces on X at posting. At-publication feature set verified on one modern detail page (measurements.detail_page_schema_2026_11_07): product codes (EAN/batch), 販売期間 sales period, 対象台数 affected units, remedy, reason, business + 法人番号, plus the register row's own fields (sub-category, red-text major-accident marker, overseas-business marker). AVAILABILITY CAVEAT (measured): updated rows link to the CURRENT detail-page revision (measurements.detail_page_revision_finding), and the register revises entries in place (two-date markers), so per-row feature values as of each row's own publication day need Wayback vintages or must be restricted to register-row stable fields; the task is a current-compilation retrospective (explicit evaluation_contract assumptions) unless the Wayback probe bounds historical availability. Detail-page field sets across eras (pre-2015 pages, category variations) still need the bounded verification named in next_action.
target_definition: DRAFT: binary label = the same register row later carries a second date plus a substantive update marker (対象追加 / 型番追加 / 品番追加・対象期間拡大 / 対策内容更新) within the pre-registered window (365-day primary variant; the update-lag distribution must be measured from the full register first - measured examples span 42 days to ~4.9 years, so the window choice changes the base rate materially and must be set from full-register counts, not this sample). Label source columns (the second date and marker) are excludable from what ships. Population: every recall published on the METI register since 2007-05-14, one row per recall publication; eligibility is publication-based, never outcome-based.

sources.name: METI 製品安全ガイド リコール情報 (recall register index + category pages)
sources.api: Anonymous HTTPS; 9-10 category hubs (baby, daidokoro, denki, hoken, kagu, minomawari, nenshou, norimono, rejya, seni) each listing sub-pages (~20 known sub-pages); register covers recalls since 平成19年5月14日 (2007-05-14). Host constraint measured 2026-11-07: hub pages 403 to plain clients (denki.html -> 403/5,045 bytes) while sub-pages serve 200; a ~10-request plain-client burst then triggers empty 200s or an HTTP 202 WAF challenge interstitial (2,483 bytes); spaced single fetches (>=3 s) with a browser-like UA succeed (denki_5.html -> 200/63,763 bytes twice). Pages are mixed/legacy-encoded (shift_jis-like); naive utf-8 decode destroys most content.
sources.access: open; plain-client enumeration needs polite pacing or the supported browser

license_evidence: METI 利用規約 (https://www.meti.go.jp/main/rules.html, fetched 2026-11-07, 16,703 bytes, mixed/legacy encoding, plain HTTP GET with a browser-like UA): '経済産業省ウェブサイト（以下「当ウェブサイト」といいます。）で掲載・発信している情報（以下「コンテンツ」といいます。）の著作権は、特記されていない限り経済産業省に帰属し、権利表記の記載がない限り「公共データ利用規約（第1.0版）」（PDL1.0）に準拠した利用条件の下で、利用することができます。' plus the 出典記載 rules, the editing-disclosure rule ('コンテンツを編集・加工等して利用する場合は、上記出典とは別に、編集・加工等を行ったことを記載してください。...編集・加工した情報を、あたかも国（又は府省等）が作成したかのような態様で公表・利用してはいけません。') and the third-party-rights clause ('第三者が著作権その他の権利を有している場合があります。...利用の許諾を得てください。').

NITE homepage terms (https://www.nite.go.jp/homepage/policy.html, read 2026-11-07): '...特に但し書きがない限り、すべての情報は機構もしくは原権利者の著作物です。本ホームページの情報を私的利用など一定の範囲以外の目的で...複製、公衆送信、送信可能化などの行為を行うことは...違法行為となります。' and '使用する場合は、機構の使用許諾が必要となります。' -> NITE channel is class D for redistribution of its data; no dataset-specific but-clause was found for the SAFE-Lite recall data in this session's probes.

The METI register pages carry no separate dataset-level licence field; the site-level PDL 1.0 default governs them ('特記されていない限り'), verified on the register index and denki_5.html (no additional copyright notice on the recall content itself). The METI footer 'Copyright Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry. All Rights Reserved.' is the rights statement the site terms then route, for content without further notice, into PDL 1.0.
split_strategy: UNKNOWN - the recorded split-capacity gap. One sub-page (highest-volume category, ~210 rows 2007-2026) measured ~3-4% outcome-class update base rate. The full register (all ~20 sub-pages, expected O(1,500-3,000) recalls over 2007-2026, per-year volume rising) must be enumerated before split windows can be counted; positives cluster by business and incident (one defective product line produces multiple recalls and linked updates - e.g. EcoFlow/Anker multiple rows on denki_5), so clustered positive counts by (business, year) must be reported alongside raw counts. No figure from this session may be quoted as the register's count.

The update-lag distribution must be measured on the full register before the target window is fixed.
measurements.cross_category_marker_confirmation: kagu page (rendered excerpt, 2026-11-07): 2025-01-24 折りたたみ椅子 -> 2025-02-19 （対象追加） (株式会社良品計画); 2023-01-12 鏡 -> 2023-09-13 （対象追加） (イケア・ジャパン). The marker family exists across categories, in both full- and half-width parentheses.
measurements.host_constraints: METI WAF measured 2026-11-07: hub pages 403 to plain clients (denki.html 403/5,045 bytes) while sub-pages serve 200; after a ~10-request burst, plain-client fetches receive empty 200s or an HTTP 202 challenge interstitial (2,483 bytes); spaced single fetches (>=3 s) with a browser-like UA succeed. urllib-style clients received empty 200s even for pages curl served normally - use curl-class clients or the supported browser. Full-register enumeration needs polite pacing.
measurements.encoding_caveat: Register pages are mixed/legacy-encoded (shift_jis-like); naive utf-8 decoding destroys most content (0 dates found vs 225 with shift_jis/replace). Construction must pin the decoder per page.
measurements.novelty_prior_art_searched: 2026-11-07 searches (recall prediction/expansion ML benchmark; Japanese リコール 対象追加 予測): closest published artefacts - RECALL-MM (arXiv 2503.23213; US CPSC recall dataset, 6,874 recalls 2000-2024, public on GitHub; hazard classification from text/product images and risk exploration) - a US hazard-classification dataset, not a lifecycle-update/expansion prediction task and not Japanese data; SemEval-2025 Task 9 (food hazard detection: hazard/product-category prediction from recall-announcement titles, 7,546 labeled announcements); an NHTSA ESV-28 paper (early detection of vehicle safety issues from complaint data, pre-recall). No ML-ready per-recall scope-expansion prediction task on a national recall register was found. Formal check-novelty.py with recorded queries runs at ready-review.
measurements.extraction_cost_measured: Coordinator, 2026-11-07: single sub-page fetch 63,763 bytes, ~1 s with TLS. ~20 known sub-pages -> ~1.3 MB, ~20 requests, a few minutes at the required polite pacing; detail-page count unknown until enumeration. The full enumeration is a bounded discovery pass, not bulk transfer.
measurements.detail_page_schema_2026_11_07: Detail-page schema VERIFIED on one modern page (file/250825-1.html, the 2025-08-25 自転車用ライト recall, fetched 2026-11-07 as a single spaced request, 200/15,314 bytes, utf-8; older pages are shift_jis-like - decoder must be pinned per era): fields = リコール実施日 | 製品名 | リコール事業者名 + 法人番号 (Japan corporate number - a structured, joinable business identifier) | リコール実施の理由 (reason text) | リコール対策内容 (remedy: 回収・交換) | リコール製品の概要 table with 商品名 / EANコード / バッチコード / 販売期間 (sales period, e.g. 2023年5月〜2025年8月) / 対象台数 (affected units, e.g. 1,350台) | 対象製品の外観・確認方法 | 事業者問い合わせ先 | 事業者リコール情報URL | 最終更新日 (the detail page's own last-updated date: 2025-08-26, one day after publication). So the at-publication feature set is richer and more structured than the register row alone: product codes, sales period, affected-unit counts, remedy type, corporate number.
measurements.detail_page_revision_finding: AS-OF FINDING (measured, important): for the updated row 2014-05-28 -> 品番追加・対象期間拡大 2014-11-13, the register row's detail link points to file/141113-1.html - i.e. the row links to the CURRENT revision of the detail page, not the original. Feature values as of each row's own publication day therefore cannot be read from today's link for updated recalls; they need Wayback vintages (next_action step 3) or must be restricted to the register row's own stable fields. The detail page's 最終更新日 supports detecting that a detail page was revised, but does not reconstruct the original values.

next_action: Ordered handoff (discovery-owned, all steps bounded; NO construction while the operator's 2026-11-07 factory-repair directive stands - this record is buffer-only): (1) detail-page schema verification ACROSS ERAS - the modern-page schema is verified (2025 page: product/EAN/batch codes, 販売期間, 対象台数, remedy, reason, 法人番号, 最終更新日; see measurements.detail_page_schema_2026_11_07), and the current-revision link behaviour is measured for updated rows; still to verify: the same schema on 2-3 pre-2015 and other-category pages (encoding and field set vary by era), and whether 対象台数 is present for every recall; (2) full-register enumeration pass - all category hubs via the browser or polite-paced curl (~20 known sub-pages; hubs 403 to plain clients, WAF paces bursts - measured), computing per-year publication counts, per-marker update base rates, the update-lag distribution (to fix the target window), and clustered positives by (business, year) -> split capacity verdict; (3) Wayback CDX probe of 2-3 sub-page URLs (e.g. denki_5.html, kagu.html) for vintage/as-of evidence over 2007-2026, to decide current-compilation-retrospective vs vintage-bounded design; (4) cross-check against the CAA major-notice list (265 records) for known recall orders; (5) formal python3 scripts/check-novelty.py with recorded queries (RECALL-MM, SemEval-2025 Task 9, NHTSA complaints); (6) five-contract reconciliation with evidence -> ready review.
licence_note: METI site terms state that content without a special copyright notice is under 公共データ利用規約（第1.0版） (PDL 1.0). PDL 1.0 permits use with attribution (出典記載, with a stated example format), requires disclosed editing/processing ('編集・加工等を行ったことを記載してください') and forbids publishing modified data as if made by the government - so the package must carry the 出典 attribution, label the dataset as derived, and record the processing. The terms also require clearing third-party rights: recall entries embed business-written hazard text and product photographs; the task ships extracted structured facts (dates, categories, names, counts) and must NOT ship product images. The NITE channel for the same events is licence class D (not used); the CAA channel is rejected on volume. PDL 1.0 conditions land this at class B (conditional open), not class A.

jurisdiction.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (経済産業省), Consumer Product Safety - 製品安全ガイド リコール情報 register under the amended Consumer Product Safety Act (改正消費生活用製品安全法, in force 2007-05-14)

verdict: investigating: split capacity, the update-lag distribution and vintage/as-of evidence remain unmeasured, and the detail-page schema needs cross-era verification; the at-publication feature schema is verified on one modern page; all remaining facts are answerable by the bounded probes named in next_action before any construction decision.
uncertainty: Cheapest decision-changing uncertainty: does the full register carry enough outcome-class updates (対象追加-class, sample rate ~3-4%) spread across years to fill three disjoint windows with both classes? Second: do the detail pages expose structured at-publication features (affected-units count, sales period) that survive in-place revision? Both are answered by the bounded enumeration + schema probes above before any construction decision.
